name: Everyday Speaking
description: Read or listen to Spanish, then flip for English if you need it. Adapted from the supplied video transcript.

source.title: 650 SPANISH PHRASES YOU CAN USE FOREVER — Listen repeatedly and learn easily
source.note: All 645 distinct English prompts in the complete supplied DOCX are represented. Nine equivalent prompts share Spanish answers. Repetitions and the introductory line are omitted. Original regional wording is generally retained; this is not a Guatemala-only deck.
